description:
Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. Stack of PRs on main: PR1 reproducers+signal, PR2 fz-tfn.62 narrow, PR3 fz-kdt.48, PR4 fz-kdt.177 kernel, PR5 fz-kdt.177 semantics.

PR5. DeriveCallGraphComponent (jobs/keying.rs ~167) publishes CallGraphComponent(f), consumed by nothing in the semantic fixpoint; returns are published per activation per revision to every caller through a Current read (jobs/semantic.rs ~1782). Consume the SCC fact: one job iterates the members' returns locally and publishes each member's ReturnType once; a return read whose only support is inside the reader's own cone contributes no ascent (fz-kdt.64's cyclic-copies clause, landing here). Model on pull.rs ~793/2077 stage_recursive_group. Tests: compiler2_recursive_group_publishes_one_settled_return_per_member, compiler2_recursive_group_wakes_callers_once, admission-order invariance (FIFO, LIFO, permuted: identical facts and artifacts). Signal: ReturnType-caused applied steps on json_roundtrip from 1007 toward the member count; AnalyzeActivation runs per activation single digits.
title: A recursive group's returns are solved once; cyclic copies are never new ground
